article.headline: Hall scores 15, Texas State downs Incarnate Word 84-51
article.description: — D.J. Hall's 15 points helped Texas State defeat Incarnate Word 84-51 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Hall scores 15, Texas State downs Incarnate Word 84-51

keywords: Incarnate Word Cardinals @ Texas State Bobcats
article.story: SAN MARCOS, Texas -- — D.J. Hall's 15 points helped Texas State defeat Incarnate Word 84-51 on Wednesday. Hall shot 5 of 7 from the field and 5 for 5 from the line for the Bobcats (6-0). Quel'Ron House shot 5 of 7 from the field to add 12 points. Paul Djobet shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 2 for 3 from the line to finish with 11 points, while adding six rebounds. Godswill Erheriene led the Cardinals (0-5) with 15 points, six rebounds and two blocks. Jayden Thomas added 10 points for Incarnate Word. Texas State led 42-30 at halftime, with Hall racking up 13 points. Texas State extended its lead to 73-40 during the second half, fueled by an 11-0 scoring run. House scored a team-high 10 points in the second half. Up next Up next for Texas State is a Sunday matchup with McNeese at home, and Incarnate Word hosts Central Baptist on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
